title: Utility Services Terms: Prompt-Report Courtesy on Leak Adjustment Credits
content:
# Prompt-Report Courtesy — Utility Services Program Leak Adjustments

**Term.** A prompt-report courtesy is added to the credit of a Utility Services Program leak adjustment:

- **$10.00** when the suspected-leak dispute was submitted no more than 3 days after the disputed line's bill date;
- **$5.00** when it was submitted more than 3 but no more than 14 days after it;
- **$0.00** otherwise.

Days after a bill date are counted as calendar days starting the day after the bill date. The submission date is the moment recorded on the dispute. The courtesy is added to the usage part of the credit, and the sum is rounded half up to the cent.

## Boundary days (hypothetical bill date June 12)

| Dispute submitted on | Days after the bill date | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| June 15 | 3 | $10.00 |
| June 16 | 4 | $5.00 |
| June 26 | 14 | $5.00 |
| June 27 | 15 | $0.00 |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* a usage credit of $29.76 on a dispute submitted two days after the bill date becomes $39.76.
